name: Hampi
description: Wander through a surreal landscape of boulders, temple ruins, and golden-hour horizons in the heart of the Vijayanagara empire.

name: Varanasi
tagline: A city that moves to its own rhythm
description: Follow the river at dawn, share stories in the old lanes, and experience one of the world's oldest living cities with a local.

name: Mysuru
description: Discover royal architecture, fragrant markets, and the gentle pace of India's cultural capital with a guide who knows every corner.

name: Jaipur
description: Meet makers, decode palace details, and taste your way through the Pink City beyond the postcard trail.

name: Agra
tagline: A timeless love story in marble
description: See the Taj Mahal through the eyes of a local storyteller, then linger for the food, craft, and living history around it.

name: Kochi
tagline: Spice, sea, and a layered shoreline
description: Trace Kochi's trading past through art-filled warehouses, backwater sunsets, and kitchens rich with coastal flavour.
